$comment: Detector calibration for hotspot-detect.mjs (Epic A4). Externalized so other frameworks/repos can tune the heuristics without editing the detector. Loaded by hotspot-detect.mjs with these values as the built-in default; pass --calibration <path> to override. Defaults are tuned for Next.js App Router + TS.
$comment_convention: Framework-convention filenames that are REQUIRED to repeat across dirs (Next.js App Router). Excluded from duplicate-subsystem detection so they never produce 'route.ts ×N' false positives (FR7).
$comment_coLocated: Generic per-module CO-LOCATED files that legitimately recur once per feature module (every module has its own types.ts/utils.ts). They share a basename but are NOT a duplicated subsystem — 'consolidate the 10 types.ts onto one' is wrong advice. Excluded from duplicate-subsystem. Genuine copy-paste duplication of these is left to L3 adjudication / manual review, not the deterministic detector.
$comment_uiDir: Files under these dirs are design-system primitives. Duplicate basenames among them roll up under design-system-consolidation instead of duplicate-subsystem (FR7).
$comment_versionMarker: Path SEGMENTS carrying explicit LEGACY markers. hotspot-detect clusters by the FIRST marked segment (the 'version root'), collapsing a versioned dir (onboarding-v2/**) to ONE legacy-root candidate. NOTE: 'enhanced'/'hierarchical'/'-new' were REMOVED — they're feature-descriptive (often the CURRENT model, e.g. migrate-to-hierarchical proves hierarchical is new), not legacy. Numbered versions are handled by the highest-in-family=current rule; migrations/ + migrate-* are excluded.
$comment_dupExcludeDirs: Files under these path segments are intentional sibling variants/mocks that legitimately share a basename (e.g. sections/experience/variants/list.tsx vs sections/projects/variants/list.tsx) — excluded from duplicate-subsystem so they aren't flagged 'consolidate onto one'.
$comment_thresholds: godObjectMinMethods: a class needs ≥ this many method-out edges to count. lowCohesion*: community size + internal/(internal+boundary) cohesion gate. severity*: score buckets (≥critical→critical, ≥high→high, ≥medium→medium, else low).
